decision.summary: Caller Jonah Okafor (T-1002) reported a gas smell. The AI line verified him against the wrong record (T-1001, Amelia Clarke) because find_tenant was never run; his details actually match T-1002. I raised emergency JOB-101, assigned Gas Safe Bow Gas & Heating for a same-day window, messaged the tenant and landlord, and set an evening follow-up.

answers.question: What is the situation right now, and what is the most urgent thing to do?
answers.answer: A vulnerable tenant has a strong gas smell in his kitchen and is outside. Most urgent: make sure he stays out and has called NGES 0800 111 999, and get a Gas Safe engineer booked same day. Done.

answers.question: Are E-4901 and E-4902 both valid? What do you do with each, and why?
answers.answer: E-4902 (P1 gas) is valid and stays open, now backed by JOB-101. E-4901 (P3 identity failure) is invalid: the line checked T-1001 (Amelia Clarke, different person) instead of T-1002; Jonah's name, DOB and phone match T-1002. I noted this on E-4901 for a human to close and flagged the process fault. No identity check was needed to give safety advice anyway.

answers.question: What actions do you take in the next hour, and who do you tell?
answers.answer: Created and assigned JOB-101 to Bow Gas & Heating; texted the tenant (safety, apology, welfare, update this evening); emailed the landlord Margaret Ellison (emergency, approved per her notes); noted E-4901; scheduled an evening follow-up. R-4766 lock and other worries handled after the emergency.

args.body: Hi Jonah, it's Northbridge. Sorry about the trouble on the phone: our system checked the wrong record, that was our error and your details are fine. Please stay outside, don't use switches or flames, and if you haven't already call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (999 if in immediate danger). We've asked a Gas Safe engineer (Bow Gas & Heating) to attend today and will confirm their time once they do. Please don't go back in until the gas service says it's safe. Are you OK, and do you have somewhere to stay? We'll also look at the other things you're worried about, including your stiff front door lock. We'll update you again by this evening.
